blurb: The Amarillo Club was established in 1947. Since then, it has been a destination for romantic evenings, life celebrations, business meetings, special receptions, and much more. Today, more than 675 members of the Amarillo Club enjoy spectacular fine dining and cocktails atop the 30th and 31st floors of the FirstBank Southwest Tower - nestled in the heart of downtown Amarillo.
